Films and screen

More than 60 films and video albums

Since 2011 Noor has worked as a dancer, choreographer and assistant choreographer on song sequences, films and live shows with some of the best-known names in Hindi cinema.

60+ movies and video albums

Kantara character feature

For Vijay Verma's upcoming project, Noor stepped into a full Kantara look. It was less about steps and more about carrying a whole culture in the body.

The Maratha look

A song sequence for an upcoming film, playing a powerful Maratha character. The costume did half the work; the posture had to do the rest.
